tasks.title: Land the prefix conformance gate and close the namespace
tasks.goal: After every skill is prefixed, the mechanical `pyxis-*` prefix conformance test is present and green, the glossary confirms Argus persona vs `/pyxis-argus`, and no unprefixed pyxis skill remains on the live vendor surface.
tasks.current: Skills may still be mid-train or fully renamed, but no scripts-test / payload wrapper refuses a non-`pyxis-*` skills-tree directory or frontmatter `name:`; mid-train mixed names are allowed; glossary may already distinguish persona vs skill from the PRD introducing work but M1 confirm is not yet the closing checkpoint.
tasks.desired: A conformance test in the scripts-test harness, reached by CI via a Go test wrapper in the payload package (help-purity pattern), fails closed if any skills-tree directory basename or frontmatter `name:` violates `pyxis-*`, and fails if any unprefixed skill remains (closing precondition). The test did not exist before this task (mid-train absence). Glossary Argus entry distinguishes the AI Engineer persona from `/pyxis-argus`. Any leftover harness-view drift is cleared via converge regenerate, not hand edit. Engine CLI verbs and frozen merged docs are unchanged by this close.
scope: the scripts-test prefix-conformance suite plus the payload Go wrapper that invokes it under code-gate
confirmation of the Argus / `/pyxis-argus` glossary split at the M1 checkpoint
converge backstop for any remaining generated harness view drift after the rename train
out_of_scope: renaming any remaining skill (all rename tasks must already be done)
rewriting frozen merged documents for historical unprefixed strings
renaming engine CLI binaries or verbs
acceptance: the prefix conformance test is present under the scripts-test harness and fails a sandbox skill whose directory or `name:` is not `pyxis-*`
the live skills tree is entirely `pyxis-*` directories with matching frontmatter `name:` values when the test runs green
the glossary Argus entry distinguishes the persona from `/pyxis-argus`
no docgate skill-prefix check is added; generated harness views that still drifted are regenerated via converge, not hand-edited
key_interfaces: the scripts-test harness convention and the payload package Go wrapper pattern (same shape as help purity)
the skills-tree directory basename + frontmatter `name:` prefix rule (`pyxis-*`)
the glossary Argus persona vs harness-skill vocabulary split
touches: the scripts-test prefix-conformance harness · the payload Go wrapper for that harness · the glossary Argus entry · leftover generated harness view drift
